answer_1.quote: This method combines structure-aware augmented data (positive) generated by a tagging-based approach that considers structural patterns and counterfactually augmented data (negative) generated by large language models (LLMs) to create complex and diverse sentence patterns.
answer_1.outputs: Counterfactual sentences and structure-aware augmented sentences

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our generated LLM-based counterfactual augmented data (GPT-CAD) in three metrics, as shown in Table. First, we measure the number of new corpora that did not appear in the original train dataset (Diversity). Second, we calculate the ratio of corpora that overlap with the original train dataset's (Overlap). Lastly, to examine how well the generated counterfactual sentences maintain the existing context, we use BERTScore.
